profile.headline: Software Developer at Grand Valley State University
profile.summary:
As an enterprise architect and developer, I have experience in designing, developing, and implementing on-premises and cloud-based solutions for various clients and industries. I have a strong background in Microsoft products, platforms and solutions, and I am proficient in using various tools and frameworks to optimize performance, security, and scalability of cloud applications and services.

I'm also a team-builder and excellent communicator, both written and verbal, successful in bringing technical understanding to non-technical executives and staff, focused on building strong interdepartmental and client relationships.

positions.title: Cloud Solution Architect
positions.description: Enterprise architect part of the global delivery team, Culture & Cloud Experiences (CCX), dedicated to spearheading our strategic & technical initiatives and working directly with customers to shape projects that drive innovation and growth. Working in close collaboration with Product Engineering to amplify the voice of the customer and ensure that our company's outcomes are aligned with their needs and expectations while helping drive excellence internally for the entire organization.

positions.title: HOLA Dallas Fort-Worth University Relations Lead
positions.description: Accountable for establishing and maintaining strong relationships amongst academic institutions by coordinating recruitment and professional development activities, particularly for underrepresented Hispanic communities.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
SHPE's vision is a world where Hispanics are highly valued and influential as leading innovators, scientists, mathematicians and engineers. As a previous President of MSU SHPE, I had the privilege of leading an executive board to pursue this vision by providing various opportunities and resources to our organization's members that promote academic and professional success.

Chapter Website: https://www.shpeatmsu.org

company.name: Michigan State University Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
As a Teaching Assistant within the College of Engineering, I educated Computer Science and Engineering students through class instruction on the following course objectives:
- Continuation of object-centered design and implementation in C++17
- Building programs from modules 
- Data abstraction and classes to implement abstract data types 
- Static and dynamic memory allocation
- Data structure implementation and algorithm efficiency

positions.title: Student Librarian Supervisor
positions.description: As a Student Supervisor, I managed a team of Student Librarians, ensuring optimal team performance and serving as the first point of contact for resolving issues and addressing complaints. In addition to supervisory responsibilities, I operated the library service desk, providing support to patrons, troubleshooting facility hardware and software issues, coordinating interlibrary loan services, and overseeing various organizational projects as required.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed and deployed a web-based simulation tool for evolutionary game theory studies, enabling local configuration, runtime execution, and real-time monitoring of simulations like the Prisoner’s Dilemma. Leveraged C++, JavaScript, and the Emscripten Compiler for algorithm development and integration, alongside HTML, CSS, and Empirical's Web & Config libraries for crafting a user-friendly front-end interface. The application, adopted by the Avida-ED team, was distributed broadly within Michigan State University’s Natural Sciences department, supporting hundreds of students annually in classroom settings and enhancing educational outcomes.
